entries.source:
The city of Nexus clings to existence in the
aftermath of a hundred years of war. But many
evils threaten it - a monstrous sea serpent
called the Leviathan is but one. And now you
must travel to its lair and face the beast.

Smashed remains of ships surround you, and
your own vessel is forced to fight off murderous
pirates. Exhausted, you triumph. But it's only
the start. The mighty Leviathan still awaits …
